history.historicalImportance: Jamui has a rich historical legacy associated with the ancient Magadha Empire, Jainism, and the freedom movement. It is believed to be the birthplace of the 9th Jain Tirthankara, Suvidhinath (Pushpadanta).
history.formationHistory: Jamui district was carved out of the erstwhile Munger district on 21 February 1991 to improve administrative efficiency.
history.freedomMovement: The district actively participated in India's freedom struggle, and many local revolutionaries contributed to the national movement against British rule.
history.archaeologicalImportance: Jamui contains several ancient temples, Jain religious sites, forts and archaeological remains reflecting its historical and cultural significance.
historicalTimeLine: Ancient Period – Part of the Magadha Kingdom
6th Century BCE – Region associated with Jainism and Lord Mahavira
Medieval Period – Ruled by the Pala and Sena dynasties
21 February 1991 – Jamui district was formed from Munger district
Present – Developing district of Munger Division

geography.location: Jamui district is located in the south-eastern part of Bihar and forms part of the Munger Division.
geography.climate: Tropical climate with hot summers, monsoon rains and mild winters
geography.forests: Moderate forest cover, mainly in Chakai and Sono regions

specialEconomicFeatures: Tourism potential around Jain and wildlife sites

agriculture.dairyDevelopment: Dairy farming is an important supplementary source of income in rural areas.
agriculture.fisheries: Fish farming is practiced in ponds and reservoirs across the district.

infrastructure.roadNetwork: Jamui has a developing road network connecting major towns and rural areas.
infrastructure.airConnectivity: The nearest airport is Deoghar Airport (approximately 95 km). Patna Airport is also commonly used.
infrastructure.publicTransport: Bihar State Road Transport Corporation (BSRTC), private buses, taxis and auto-rickshaws.
infrastructure.electricity: Most urban and rural areas have electricity connectivity under state and central schemes.
infrastructure.waterSupply: Urban areas receive piped water supply while rural areas depend on hand pumps and government water schemes.
infrastructure.internetConnectivity: 4G and 5G mobile services are available in most parts of the district.

education.privateSchools: Several CBSE, ICSE and Bihar Board affiliated schools

healthcare.primaryHealthCentres: Primary Health Centres are available across all major blocks.

cultureAndHeritage.traditionalDress: Men traditionally wear Dhoti-Kurta while women wear Saree and Salwar-Kameez.
culturalOrganizations: District Art and Culture Office, Jamui
Bihar Department of Art, Culture and Youth

sportsAcademies: Bihar State Sports Authority Training Centre
sportsAchievements: District athletes regularly participate in state-level competitions
School and college teams represent Jamui in district and state tournaments
Growing participation in cricket, football and athletics

bankingAndFinance.atms: ATMs of major public and private sector banks are available across the district
bankingAndFinance.digitalBanking: UPI, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking and Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AEPS) are widely used

governanceAndPublicServices.districtAdministration: Jamui district is administered by the District Magistrate (DM) with support from various administrative departments.
governanceAndPublicServices.policeAdministration: Law and order is maintained by Jamui Police under the Bihar Police Department.
governanceAndPublicServices.fireServices: Fire stations operate in Jamui town and major subdivisions to provide emergency fire and rescue services.
governanceAndPublicServices.publicDistributionSystem: Essential commodities are distributed through the Public Distribution System (PDS) under the National Food Security Act.
eGovernanceServices: Bihar Right to Public Services Portal

lawAndOrder.trafficPolice: Traffic Police regulate traffic and road safety across major towns and highways in the district.
lawAndOrder.disasterManagement: The District Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) coordinates flood, drought and other emergency response measures in Jamui.

environment.forestCover: Jamui has significant forest cover, mainly in the Chakai, Sono and Khaira regions.

mediaAndCommunication.postalServices: India Post provides postal and courier services across the district through Head and Sub Post Offices.
mediaAndCommunication.telecommunication: 4G and 5G mobile connectivity is available in most urban areas, while rural connectivity is steadily improving.
